name: Ash Raider
description: A Mutagen raider in scavenged plates bound with red cloth, ash ground into every seam.
role: The look of the Ash Raiders, the Void Nomad clans that prey on outposts and trade roads.

artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
artBrief.silhouette: Hunched figure with a plated back.
artBrief.detail: Dark grey plates, dark red cloth strips and silver buckles.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Dark greys #333333 and #555555, dark reds #800000 and #660000, silver #c0c0c0.
